Title: Developer Feature: DeveloperLandingComponent
Summary: Landing page for the developer documentation section. Displays cards linking to developer topics.
Content:
## DeveloperLandingComponent

**File:** `src/app/features/developer/components/developer-landing/developer-landing.component.ts`

**Selector:** `app-developer-landing`

**Standalone:** Yes

**Imports:** `RouterLink`

**Change Detection:** `OnPush`

### State (Signals)

| Signal | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `devCards` | `DocPage[]` | Cards displayed on the landing page |

### Current Cards

| Title | Route | Icon | Description |
|-------|-------|------|-------------|
| Extension Development | `/developer/extensions` | `bi-puzzle` | Build custom extensions to expand Cyréna |

### CSS Classes

- `.developer-landing` — max-width 900px container
- `.dev-card` — hoverable card with lift animation
- `.icon-wrapper` — 56x56px icon container with primary color

### Styling Notes

- Cards use `transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease`
- Hover: `translateY(-4px)` with elevated shadow
- Icon wrapper uses `bg-primary bg-opacity-10` with `bi` icon in primary color

### Architecture Notes

- Uses `DocPage` model from global `src/app/models/doc-pagemodel.model.ts`
- Cards are clickable `<a>` elements with `routerLink`
- Responsive grid: `col-md-6` (2 cards per row on md+)
